event_summary: An orange spherical object moves from the left side of a tabletop across to the right and exits the frame while other visible objects remain stationary.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood-grain tabletop in front of a yellow couch, with a small dark object with an orange end near the rear center of the table and a black cylindrical object partly visible at the far left edge. After an initial stationary interval, an orange sphere enters from the left side of the tabletop, travels rightward across the table through the middle of the frame, approaches the right edge, and disappears off-screen. The tabletop, couch, rear-center object, and left-edge black object show no visible position change.

reasons: The tabletop and stationary objects are visible before the orange sphere appears.
The later-moving orange sphere is not yet visible in the first frame.
